The '''Galactic Alliance Marines''' were a force established for the defense of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. As of [[43 ABY]] they were under the command of [[Gavin Darklighter]].<ref name="Backlash" />
